content.short: TsunamiX is a gamified spot and margin trading protocol on Mantle enabling traders to open leveraged positions on crypto assets.
content.description: TsunamiX is a decentralized trading protocol that gamifies the experience of spot and margin trading on the Mantle Network, adding game-like mechanics and reward layers to sophisticated leveraged trading. The platform allows traders to open leveraged positions across a wide range of crypto assets, with EcoFund backing from Mantle supporting its deep integration into the network's DeFi infrastructure. TsunamiX blends the engagement of gaming with the financial tools of professional derivatives trading.
